name: Lytical
description_en:
Lytical is a product in the Marketing analytics category. Its directory profile covers Spend Analysis, Cross Device Tracking, Campaign Performance Tracking, Attribution, AI-Powered Insights, KPI Monitoring, Data Source, Conversion Tracking.

Additional listed capabilities include Interactive Dashboard, Ad hoc Reports, Collaboration. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $29.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record defined completion events in a user journey. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出交互式仪表盘、临时报表、协作。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。
